answer: One state mountain-guide licence backs exactly one identity. Licences are capped per karst region; each names one guide, and a second claim on it is rejected. Earning it takes an exam, a 240-day apprenticeship guiding clients through karst gorges past willow trailheads, and 1,100 units in fees: each fake costs one trained person, 1,100 units and 240 days, so 100 fakes cost 110,000 units and 24,000 days. The cheapest cheat is hiring a licensed guide to front for a fake: the guide surrenders the licence backing their own identity, and a face-to-licence check at the harbor burns the fake.
